note: Governed deferral records. OM-018 requires deferred scope to be recorded, never left as an informal later list.

deferred_machinery.item: authenticated freshness optimization and affected-test selection
deferred_machinery.reason: Not a pre-entry obligation. Where selection is uncertain it is turned off and the full population executes.

deferred_machinery.item: review transport and review state machine, including its twelve declared edges, retry budgets and terminal states
deferred_machinery.reason: No row of the sixteen-command admission gate executes review-scope or review-check, so the state machine is not exercised by entry.

deferred_machinery.item: the remediation closure matrix as an admission gate
deferred_machinery.destination: retained as a disclosure and backlog register only
deferred_machinery.reason: The controller reads neither closure_state nor GREEN_PROVED; matrix closure was procedural, never mechanical.

deferred_machinery.item: the prior-finding topic census as a precondition for starting B0
deferred_machinery.reason: Registry preserved; a historical topic replay is not the price of starting B0.

deferred_machinery.destination: B8, after the round has done its work
deferred_machinery.reason: One cold pre-entry execution suffices for admission.
Refactoring now would maximize the Review Run 2 diff.

deferred_machinery.destination: R-0007, as a non-reentrant per-command proof that does not live inside a suite the roster executes
deferred_machinery.reason: Independent per-command cold executability: every authoritative command exits zero when started independently in its own freshly installed detached clone, without relying on artifacts produced by earlier roster rows. This was OM-017 language, was proved only by the deleted R7-005-SIXTEEN-LITERAL-DETACHED contract, and is NOT proved elsewhere. The OM-018 admission run proves a weaker property: all sixteen pass sequentially in one clean detached clone, so an order dependency between rows would not be detected pre-entry. Deferred with that loss stated, not hidden.

control_surface_freeze: No new generic control machinery lands before R-0007 entry. A defect found in proof machinery is resolved by deleting or deferring that machinery, not by wrapping it in a further schema, matrix, census or gate.
